# Tim's Game Lab (game-factory.tech)

> A curated collection of small, original browser games and official platform releases. New experiments arrive regularly and player feedback shapes what gets improved.

## About
- Free to play in any browser (desktop or mobile). No download, no account.
- Some games run here; official releases open on their verified distribution platform.
- Interface and game copy are available in English and Russian (plus Spanish, Portuguese, Turkish, Arabic) via `?lang=`.
- New games are added most days; players vote to shape what gets built next.
- Browse everything: https://game-factory.tech/  -  Russian: https://game-factory.tech/?lang=ru

## Curated games
- Live curated index: https://game-factory.tech/

## Also
- New-games feed (RSS): https://game-factory.tech/rss.xml
- Sitemap: https://game-factory.tech/sitemap.xml
- Make your own game from one sentence: https://game-factory.tech/create
